question: Where should the siddhis beginning with aṇimā be worshipped?
premises: The siddhis beginning with aṇimā are the objects of worship.
The locations named are the tip of the yantra and the sixteen-petalled lotus.
inference: One should worship the siddhis beginning with aṇimā at the tip of the yantra and in the sixteen-petalled lotus.
plain_english: One should worship the siddhis beginning with aṇimā at the tip of the yantra and in the sixteen-petalled lotus.
